name: LilyGO T-Dongle C5 + LED Arcade Button 1x4 (seesaw 5296)
description: Tests the WipperSnapper expander (Adafruit Seesaw) + digitalio path on a LilyGO T-Dongle C5, using an Adafruit LED Arcade Button 1x4 STEMMA QT breakout (PID 5296, ATtiny817 seesaw, default I2C addr 0x3A) on the T-Dongle's StemmaQT/UART pads (SCL=D12 / SDA=D11 — same pads the i2c-scan and pm25-uart scripts use). Position 1 has an arcade LED button wired: seesaw pin 12 = LED (digital OUTPUT), seesaw pin 18 = switch (digital INPUT_PULL_UP). Flow: checkin -> add seesaw expander -> add LED pin (EXP_0x3a_12) with an initial ON write -> add button pin (EXP_0x3a_18, event mode, active-low inverted). Expander pins are named EXP_0x<addr>_<pin>. Manually toggle the LED with the led-off / led-on steps (POST /api/scripts/<name>/steps/<step>/send). Uses the migrate-api-v2 (api-v2-pins-as-strings) expander/digitalio/i2c proto shapes.

steps.name: checkin-response
steps.description: Respond to device checkin with OK and board capabilities

steps.name: add-expander
steps.description: Add the Adafruit Seesaw expander (Arcade QT) at 0x3A on SCL=D12 / SDA=D11.

steps.name: add-led
steps.description: Add the arcade LED on seesaw pin 12 as a digital OUTPUT and turn it ON.

steps.name: add-button
steps.description: Add the arcade switch on seesaw pin 18 as INPUT_PULL_UP, event mode, active-low (inverted so pressed = true).

steps.name: led-off
steps.description: Manual step: turn the arcade LED OFF (POST .../steps/led-off/send).

steps.name: led-on
steps.description: Manual step: turn the arcade LED ON (POST .../steps/led-on/send).
